name: Obsidian Forge-Tombs
identity: Undying tomb-dwarves of obsidian and liquid gold. Slow (MOV 4–5), heavily armoured, and they reanimate: a squad that is not wiped out comes back. One public Grudge, moved to whoever last killed an Obsidian unit, focuses their wrath.

rules.name: Grudge-Reanimation · The Grudge
rules.description: Reanimation: at the End of Round, each Obsidian unit that is still on the battlefield rolls a D6: on a 4+ it returns 1 slain model (Class 1–2) or heals D3 MIGHT (Class 3–5). The Grudge: before the battle name 1 enemy unit as the Grudge. Obsidian units re-roll Wound rolls of 1 against it. When the Grudge is destroyed, or an enemy unit destroys an Obsidian unit, move the Grudge to that enemy unit (only one Grudge at a time).

rules.name: Gamble — Burn the Ancestor-Spark
rules.description: When a unit is selected to Shoot or Fight: +1 Damage and [IMPALING HITS] on its weapons this activation; that unit can never reanimate again. (Risk: resource (permanent).)

detachments.name: Immortal Shield-Wall
detachments.playstyle: Slow, unbreakable infantry blocks around objectives.

rules.name: Gromril Shield-Wall
rules.description: Enemies cannot re-roll Wound rolls against Obsidian Class 1–2 units; units within 3″ of an objective reanimate on a 3+.

enhancements.name: Ancestor's Shield
enhancements.description: **High Thane of the Gate** only. The attached unit has WARD 5+.

enhancements.name: Oath-Stone
enhancements.description: **Obsidian Hearth-Guard** only. +1 CTRL per model and cannot be moved by enemy abilities.

stratagems.name: Stand of the Ancients
stratagems.effect: It is not Rattled and gets +1 to Hit on its Retaliation Strike.

stratagems.name: Magma-Tunnel Relocation
stratagems.effect: An unengaged unit within 6″ of a table edge is placed within 6″ of another point on the same table edge, >8″ from enemies.

detachments.name: Grudge-Hunters
detachments.playstyle: Thunderers and hammerers marching on the Grudge.

rules.name: Book of Grudges
rules.description: Against the Grudge, Obsidian units re-roll all Wound rolls (not just 1s) and get +2″ MOV toward it.

enhancements.name: Grudge-Rune
enhancements.description: **Grudge-Thane Champion** only. Re-roll all melee Wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Marked in Gold
enhancements.description: **Rune-Seer** only. The Grudge cannot gain Cover.

stratagems.name: Unforgiven
stratagems.effect: Gain 1 CP and heal D3 MIGHT on the unit that destroyed it.

stratagems.name: Write It Down
stratagems.effect: The killer becomes the Grudge AND is Rattled.

detachments.name: Rune-Forge
detachments.playstyle: Golems, engines and master-runes for one decisive round.

rules.name: Forge-Runes
rules.description: Class 3–5 Obsidian units reanimate on a 3+; the Master-Rune can be struck twice per battle (different runes).

enhancements.name: Anvil of Ages
enhancements.description: **Tomb-Priest** only. Once per round, heal D3 MIGHT on a Class 3–5 unit within 3″.

stratagems.name: Strike the Rune
stratagems.effect: It gains one Master-Rune effect this activation.

stratagems.name: Rune of Wrath
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6″ suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+.
